## Checklist

- [ ] Title uses conventional format (`feat(scope): …`, `fix: …`); if an issue exists, the description says `Closes #N`
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have added or updated tests, or explained above why this change is not covered by tests
- [ ] I have updated documentation (README, ROADMAP, CHANGELOG, DECISIONS) for any new or changed functionality
- [ ] I have written testing instructions and verified them locally
- [ ] I have noted any required post-merge steps
- [ ] This PR contains no breaking changes (APIs, config, storage format), or they are explicitly documented above
- [ ] AI use is disclosed above, and I can explain every change without "the AI wrote it"
- [ ] Automated checks pass; I'm not leaving a red CI for someone else
